entries.question:
Subject: Inquiry About Admission Requirements

Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings. I am interested in joining King George’s Medical University for the B.Sc in Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology course. I would like to know the detailed requirements and eligibility criteria for admission to this program.

Could you please provide information regarding the qualification marks, entrance exams, and application dates?

Thank you for your time and assistance.
I look forward to your response.

Warm regards,
Sumerica Mawiong
entries.answer: You're welcome! If you have any more questions about KGMU, don't hesitate to ask. | "आपका स्वागत है! यदि आपके पास KGMU के बारे में और प्रश्न हैं, तो पूछने में संकोच न करें।"
